claims.repro_pattern_description: To obtain the negative phi value reported by Alves et al, the data needed to be rearranged. Without rearranging, the phi value is +.24. The data was rearranged by swapping the two columns: While R (and SPSS) are ordering the columns by default in a way that 0 is in the first column and 1 in the second, Alves et al. have presumably coded the first column as 1 and the second as 0. Doing the latter returns the negative phi-value of -.24, while leaving the chi squared value unchanged. The R-file contains both the code to compute the positive and negative phi-value.
